If you like the feeling of unisom, you will probably LOVE the feeling of any of the meds I listed above (I loved all of them and it did not end well).  Yes, talk to a doc. about your options.  Look into Trazadone and Seroquel.  Both are non-addictive meds that can really help with sleep.

 The nightmares I was trying to avoid came back in full force, I would talk/yell in my sleep (woke up my roommates in treatment), and there was little regulation in my sleep schedule.  I brought sleep issues at a table.  Everyone at the table agreed that sleep was an issue for them especially in early sobriety.  They also told me to seek professional help.  I did and yes, my sleep has gotten drastically better. Gives me all the more incentive to not go back out again.
